Animal Aid Unlimited is a leading street animal rescue center in India. Our hospital and sanctuary are home to more than 15,000 rescued and recovering animals each year. 

Please share our videos to support street animal rescue! 

Every donation, no matter how small, makes our life-saving rescues possible. Thank you for joining our rescue team.
